html:
MS-13, or Mara Salvatrucha, is a street gang founded by Salvadoran refugees in Los Angeles in the 1980s. It spread to El Salvador and its neighbours when the United States deported its members in the 1990s.

Young people who had fled the civil war formed the gang for protection in the barrios of Los Angeles. Deportations sent thousands of members to a El Salvador still recovering from war, where the gang and its rival, Barrio 18, grew to control whole neighbourhoods through extortion and murder.

By 2015 El Salvador had one of the highest murder rates in the world, and gang violence drove many to flee. In 2022 President Nayib Bukele declared a state of emergency and jailed tens of thousands of suspected members, and murders fell sharply, at the cost of mass detentions without trial. The gang also spread among the diaspora.
sum: MS-13, or Mara Salvatrucha, is a street gang founded by Salvadoran refugees in Los Angeles in the 1980s. It spread to El Salvador and its neighbours when the United States deported its members in the 1990s.
